title: FemTheme Trio #019 · 여 바이올린 힙 아워글래스·군인 테마 / 여 아워글래스 밤쉘·메이드 테마 / 여 아마조네스·닌자 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sandy Giza plateau with the great pyramids behind her, a smooth flat sand path and a standard-height stone doorway block at her side, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Indian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, cool ash-grey hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver ship's anchor, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a copper barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver rings. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge and two silver dog-tag chains around her neck, a tiny camouflage-pattern micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal camouflage-pattern micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

CENTER: ONE real adult Turkish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on copper chain (a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold barrel-shaped weight, a silver ship's anchor, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a bronze miniature anvil, a silver hammer head, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold bracelets. CENTER Footwear: Extreme hot-pink thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Latina woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a tin ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked mixed-metal necklaces. Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
